setup.name: Deploy and verify LVS
setup.query: Use the benchmark-unified-memory skill to orchestrate setup and the vss-deploy-profile skill to deploy the LVS profile with Elasticsearch, VIOS, and the VLM. After all required services are healthy, follow the benchmark skill's project-local CLI setup instructions to configure the deployment against `http://localhost:7777` and verify it with `vss configure check`.
checks: The LVS profile and its required Elasticsearch, VIOS, and VLM services are running and healthy.
The project-local vss CLI is configured for the deployed profile.

setup.name: Download and ingest benchmark videos
setup.query: Use the benchmark-unified-memory and vss-manage-video-io-storage skills. Download and extract the pinned NGC resource `nvidia/vss-developer/dev-profile-sample-data:3.2.0` into `$TMPDIR/videos`. Ingest only `warehouse_sample.mp4` and `sample-sim-traffic.mp4` into VIOS, using each filename stem as its sensor name.
checks: Every video ID required by the benchmark Parquet exists as a downloaded video filename stem under `$TMPDIR/videos`.
Every required video ID exists as a VIOS video sensor name.

setup.name: Initialize frozen unified memories
setup.query: Use the benchmark-unified-memory skill to initialize every frozen JSON memory under `datasets/physical-ai-video-mme-v2/memory`.
checks: Every frozen unified-memory record is readable from Elasticsearch by its authoritative record ID.

The OpenClaw daily VSS note under `~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/` contains one complete marked block for every verified parent summary job ID, including its sensor context and authoritative Elasticsearch pointer.
